inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Venus in Taurus in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: 4 Steps to Read Your Venus in Taurus Placement
inline.altEn: Four-step sequence for reading Venus in Taurus: confirm placement, locate house, check aspects, log degree and life proofs

items.subEn: Find Venus in your natal chart and verify its sign is Taurus — not the Sun sign, not a passing transit.
Note the life area where the pull toward pleasure, beauty, and value is most visible.
A conjunction, square, trine, opposition, or sextile changes how freely those preferences show.
Note Venus's exact degree and orb, then track three repeated choices — around affection, purchases, food, or routine — and see whether they match the reading.

inline.titleEn: Common Misreadings vs. What Venus in Taurus Actually Means
inline.altEn: Comparison of four common Venus in Taurus myths against their accurate interpretations

linesEn: A taste for quality is about value and durability, not measuring love by price.
The placement favors steady affection, but loyalty is built by choices and boundaries, not handed over by a sign.
Venus also covers taste, money, friendship, and creative choices — the pattern shows up well beyond dating.
The classic shadow is possessiveness and clinging to comfort; it is a risk to watch, not a guaranteed trait.
